Our services

Hair cuts, color and styling — done right

Our mission is style. Every visit starts with listening to what you want, then our stylists use their expertise to deliver a look that fits you.

Men’s Haircuts

Clean, sharp cuts tailored to your style — from classic to modern, finished with quality American Crew products.

Women’s Haircuts

Cuts shaped around your face, your hair and your lifestyle — from a fresh trim to a whole new look.

Hair Styling

Blowouts, up-dos and everyday styling for work, weddings and special occasions — style like no other.

Hair Treatments

Deep conditioning and repair treatments that restore shine, strength and health to your hair.

We also offer professional hair color — ask your stylist about rich, lasting color for your next visit.
